image_description: A side-profile view of a large, muscular dog with a short, reddish-brown coat standing on sandy ground. The dog exhibits the characteristic 'ridge' of reversed hair along its spine. It has a long head, floppy ears, and a lean, athletic build typical of a sighthound or hunting breed. The background consists of green foliage and a blue corrugated fence.

Forelegs and hindlegs appear straight with good bone structure and muscle tone.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is thick at base, tapering, and carried in slight curve.

The blue corrugated fence in the background has slight waviness that doesn't perfectly align with rigid perspective lines, though it is subtle.
